items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I remember when Goodman and Hammond and them heard of it, they couldn't believe it

ctx.x: But they were so well organized, they broadcasted every night, too, at 12:00. And they were so well organized that I remember when Goodman and Hammond and them heard of it, they couldn't believe it, a small band like that sounding so big.

And so these things were all made by head. And you notice that our band was made by head the same way. Now, most of those riffs that we had in our band, Bird or John Jackson, that set them two alto players, (unintelligible). And then Buddy or Piggy set the riffs for the brass.
